newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki off, jittery with U.S. ahead of Greenspan.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki off, jittery with U.S. ahead of Greenspan.

text.p: Shares slipped on Monday as the dollar corrected lower, with focus on reactions to U.S. Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan's testimony due this week, brokers said. The market was wary but calm.
The HEX general index fell 0.73 percent to close at 2,851.89 points, with insurers leading losses as investors took profits from their recent strength.
The tone was cautious ahead of Greenspan's semi-annual Humphrey-Hawkins testimony to Congress on Wednesday and Thursday. "Players are on their toes ahead of Greenspan's speech," one broker said.
Bourse engine Nokia fell 4.50 markka to close at 301.50, then opened at about the same level in New York.

Metals and mining group Outokumpu eased after a slightly bigger than expected fall in 1996 earnings but reactions were muted and the share closed off lows at 84.40, down 0.60 markka, with a recovery in profits expected this year.
Consumer goods group Hackman was down 4.00 markka or over three percent at 125.00 markka after it fell into the red in 1996, but trade was very thin.
